name: Winamp Group
summary: Winamp Group SA operates globally within the digital music industry. The firm's portfolio includes the iconic Winamp audio player, Bridger – a specialized copyright management platform for artists – and a wide array of themed digital and music radio channels. Beyond these offerings, it empowers artists with comprehensive solutions for the promotion, distribution, and licensing of their musical works. Headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, the company was established in 2007. It previously operated as Llama Group SA before officially rebranding to Winamp Group SA in October 2025.
